before:
`flask.app.Flask.do_teardown_request` runs the teardown callbacks in reverse
registration order and stops at the first one that raises.
after:
`flask.app.Flask.do_teardown_request` runs the teardown callbacks in reverse
registration order. All callbacks are called even if one raises; any errors
are collected via `_CollectErrors` and re-raised together (as a
`BaseExceptionGroup` on Python 3.11+) after every callback has run.
said:
